model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the negative log probability of per-specialty terms for the Mistralv0.2-Base model, with bars grouped by the six medical specialties—Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics—along the horizontal axis, labeled “Per-specialty terms.” Each group contains six bars, one for each specialty, color-coded according to a legend: light blue for Mistralv0.2-Base, light beige for Cardio, light orange for Gastro, orange for Infect, dark orange for Neuro, brown for Obstetrics, and dark brown for Pediatrics. The vertical axis, labeled “Negative log probability,” is scaled linearly from -22 to -27, with tick marks at integer intervals. Within each specialty group, the bars are arranged in descending order of height, with the Mistralv0.2-Base bar (light blue) consistently appearing as the shortest (least negative) bar, indicating the highest probability, while the Pediatrics bar (dark brown) is consistently the tallest (most negative) bar, indicating the lowest probability. The chart visually compares how well the base model predicts terms within each specialty, with the fine-tuned versions (colored bars) generally showing higher (less negative) values than the base model, suggesting improved performance for those terms.
